query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM user_last_seen
                WHERE user_id = $1 AND seen_at >= $2
            ) OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM activity_events
                WHERE actor_id = $1
                  AND actor_id LIKE 'macro|%'
                  AND agent_correlation_id IS NULL
                  AND occurred_at >= $2
                  AND action <> ALL($3)
            ) AS "active!"
